name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next GSQ-RCO IQ3_S (one GGUF's weights, INT8-class KV everywhere): Infernix, llama.cpp, Strata and Basalt

engines.name: llama.cpp b12128 prompt
engines.settings: CUDA, its default placement (--fit: the experts it cannot fit run on the CPU), Q8_0 KV (-ctk/-ctv q8_0), -b 512, logits rounded to BF16 (LLAMA_KLD_ROUND_BF16)

engines.name: llama.cpp b12128 decode T4
engines.settings: the same, the first half one prompt batch and the rest in windows of 4 forced tokens (a speculative verify of 3 drafts, every draft the text's; LLAMA_KLD_DECODE_T=4)

engines.name: Strata v0.2.11 decode
engines.settings: its setup's IQ3_S configuration (INT8 KV, MTP --spec 4 --spec-min-p 0.5, expert cache auto, its default route tail skip ON); every token of the chunk read through its decode (verify) windows, as its own quality tool reads them (its --short-read sends a longer prompt wholly through the batched path, which computes no logits)

engines.name: Basalt v0.2.1 decode
engines.settings: native Windows, its GSQ-RCO IQ3_S pack (format 2), INT8 KV, its ppl_gate protocol (the first half one prompt, the rest through verify windows of 4)
